_readme: FIAT HANDS, THE STAGES (6 Nov, Matt: "include the new backdrops and items from yesterday"): the fight's hands for the stages' 4 new weapons, 280x210 at $0.08 each (about $0.32).

The 6 Nov reroll's template: no style_image, the weapon in words, big_revolver.png the reference. Straight to art/fight/hands/<slug>.png; they show once the ART_AS entries for these bases come off (the wiring step).
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_hands_stages_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

jobs.description: First-person view of the player's own two hands in fingerless wool gloves holding a single garden digging fork with four steel tines, a wooden shaft and a D-shaped wooden handle, held forward low like a spear, the right hand on the D-handle and the left hand round the shaft near the tines - a fork, not a pitchfork, not a rake, coming in from the bottom right corner of the frame, as in a light-gun arcade game; the sleeves of a worn work jacket at the wrists. Seen from behind and just above the hands, strongly foreshortened: the tines point away into the scene towards the middle of the frame and the handle comes towards the viewer at the bottom right; not a side view, not in profile. The same viewpoint and framing as the reference image of the revolver. One fork only, held by exactly two hands. Only the hands and what they hold, coming in from the bottom right edge. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos.
jobs._where: your hands: Garden fork (primary; falls back to hands_melee) - the stages' new weapon, the 6 Nov reroll's template
